references.text: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. This shows Moses' age earlier in his service.
Joseph died at the age of one hundred and ten. Another patriarch who lived a long life.
Isaac grew old, and his eyes became so dim that he could not see. In contrast to Moses, Isaac lost his sight in old age.
Caleb says he is still as strong as when Moses sent him out, even though he is eighty-five years old. A similar example of preserved strength in advanced age.
Israel's eyes were heavy with age, so he could not see. A contrast to Moses who kept his sight.
Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor. Aaron's age at his death compared with Moses.
Moses says he is one hundred and twenty years old and can no longer go out and come in. Moses' own statement about his age.
